description: This file contains API test cases for the EmployeeLeaveAPI class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin, specifically testing the API endpoints related to employee leave functionalities. It uses the PHPUnit framework and includes methods for testing 'getAll', 'create', 'delete', and their validation rules.
